show: Sober Cast: An (unofficial) Alcoholics Anonymous Podcast AA

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Three women share their experiences on recovery, motherhood, and finding connection in AA.
kurzfassung: Three speakers share their personal journeys of overcoming alcoholism and navigating life's challenges through the principles of Alcoholics Anonymous. They discuss the stigma faced by women with alcohol dependence, the transformation of family dynamics and parenting after achieving sobriety, and the shift from isolation to genuine connection with humanity. Throughout their talks, they emphasize the importance of spiritual growth, daily persistence, and letting go of perfectionism.
stichpunkte: Joey reflects on the transition from heavy drinking to a fulfilling life centered on daily spiritual progress and gratitude.
The stigma of alcoholism hits women particularly hard because society expects them to be constant caretakers.
Forming supportive friendships with other women in AA replaced old patterns of competition and mistrust.
Patsy describes the chaotic reality of raising children and maintaining relationships while struggling with severe alcohol abuse.
Escaping into blackouts and bar stools provided a temporary illusion of control and superiority over a dull existence.
Entering AA helped Patsy replace destructive relationship patterns and unrealistic fantasies with honest self-acceptance.
Janet discusses her initial resistance to being singled out as a woman in AA due to perfectionism and intellectual pride.
Spiritual growth requires approaching a higher power through genuine spiritual connection rather than intellectual trivia.

clips.hook: The wealthiest woman in the world through friendships
clips.text: The speaker considers herself exceptionally wealthy not due to financial assets, but because the program provided deep and meaningful female friendships she previously lacked.

clips.hook: Finding a sense of peace on the 38th floor
clips.text: After years of turmoil, the speaker marvels at waking up in a hotel feeling genuinely good about herself and her new reality.

clips.hook: Drinking without limits until blacking out
clips.text: Alcohol consumption followed a destructive pattern of drinking straight through until consciousness was completely lost.

clips.hook: Feeling left out when an adult son goes out
clips.text: An older mother catches herself feeling rejected and jealous when her adult son leaves the house to spend time with his friends.
